localChanges: Settlers can now pillage the square they are standing on (Shift+P), as military units can (closes #182). Caravans and Diplomats no longer can, as in the original.
The mine command (M) now turns Jungle, Swamp and Grassland into Forest, as it already did on Plains (closes #196). Irrigating Jungle or Swamp still clears it to Grassland.
